method: Same public synthetic sentences, same references, same seed 2026; sequential runs in one loaded model. Baseline 10 steps, active-prefix 10 steps, active-prefix plus reference cache 10 steps, optional fast 4 steps. Measures actual synthesis wall time and generated speech duration; no SRT gaps or artificial silence.

asr.method: Whisper base multilingual offline CPU int8, explicit language, no prompt, beam 5

limitations: Two very short synthetic sentences cannot establish throughput for one hour, all languages, all voices, or the user computer.
The 4-step Japanese result was shorter and automatic transcription differed at the ending. Fast mode remains an explicit speed/quality choice; the first-run balanced mode is retained.
ASR is an automated approximation; it does not verify every word, speaker identity, naturalness, or emotion.
Attention microbenchmarks do not describe complete synthesis throughput.
